translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.74:1: O you covered up ˹in your clothes˺
verses.74:6: Do not do a favour expecting more ˹in return˺
verses.74:7: And persevere for ˹the sake of˺ your Lord
verses.74:8: ˹For˺ when the Trumpet will be sounded
verses.74:9: that will ˹truly˺ be a difficult Day—
verses.74:10: far from easy for the disbelievers
verses.74:11: And leave to me ˹O Prophet˺ the one I created all by Myself
verses.74:13: and children always by his side
verses.74:14: and made life very easy for him
verses.74:15: Yet he is hungry for more
verses.74:16: But no! ˹For˺ he has been truly stubborn with Our revelations
verses.74:17: I will make his fate unbearable
verses.74:18: for he contemplated and determined ˹a degrading label for the Quran˺
verses.74:19: May he be condemned! How evil was what he determined
verses.74:20: May he be condemned even more! How evil was what he determined
verses.74:23: then turned his back ˹on the truth˺ and acted arrogantly
verses.74:24: saying, “This ˹Quran˺ is nothing but magic from the ancients
verses.74:25: This is no more than the word of a man.”
verses.74:26: Soon I will burn him in Hell
verses.74:27: And what will make you realize what Hell is
verses.74:28: It does not let anyone live or die
verses.74:31: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity
verses.74:33: and the night as it retreats
verses.74:34: and the day as it breaks
verses.74:35: Surely Hell is one of the mightiest catastrophes—
verses.74:37: to whichever of you chooses to take the lead or lag behind
verses.74:38: Every soul will be detained for what it has done
verses.74:39: except the people of the right
verses.74:40: who will be in Gardens, asking one another
verses.74:41: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺
verses.74:43: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed
verses.74:44: nor did we feed the poor
verses.74:45: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others
verses.74:46: and deny the Day of Judgment
verses.74:47: until the inevitable came to us.”
verses.74:48: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them
verses.74:49: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder
verses.74:50: as if they were spooked zebras
verses.74:52: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺
verses.74:53: But no! In fact, they do not fear the Hereafter
verses.74:54: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder
verses.74:55: So let whoever wills be mindful of it
verses.74:56: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive
